response.title: COVID19-HPSMP: COVID-19 Adopted Hybrid and Parallel Deep
response.label_definition: Within a 5 day prediction horizon, assign daily output 1 when adjusted stock price is greater than the previous day and 0 when it is less; final 5-day label is 1/rise if the sum of daily outputs is greater than threshold 3, and 0/fall when the number of 0 outputs within the 5-day window is more than 3.
data_requirements: Historical stock market prices for the Dow Jones stock market index from 01/01/2016 to 30/07/2020.
Associated Twitter messages for the same period.
Trading-day-aligned dataframe combining historical prices and Tweet corpora, excluding weekends, half trading days, and market holidays.
Chronological split: training from January 2016 to January 2020, validation from January 2020 to February 2020, and test from 01/03/2020 to 30/07/2020.
feature_groups: Historical market data including adjusted close, open, high, low, and calculated target.
Twitter text/news corpora, including COVID-19-related tweet presence.
GloVe word embeddings for tokenized Twitter text.
model_families: COVID19-HPSMP hybrid parallel deep information fusion framework
integrated CNN and bidirectional LSTM path
response.training_protocol: Use the COVID19 PRIMO dataset split chronologically into training data from January 2016 to January 2020, validation data from January 2020 to February 2020, and test data from 01/03/2020 to 30/07/2020. Twitter corpora are tokenized, words occurring less than 5 times are removed, GloVe embeddings are used in the embedding modules, and training uses a five day horizon, batch size 64, and 15 epochs. Optimizer, loss function, seed, early stopping, and exact input window length are unknown.
response.evaluation_protocol: Fixed chronological holdout evaluation on data from 01/03/2020 to 30/07/2020 after training on January 2016 to January 2020 and validation on January 2020 to February 2020. The selected reported row is the proposed COVID19-HPSMP Framework in Table 1 for binary 5-day stock movement prediction.
response.preprocessing_protocol: Create a trading-day dataframe by combining historical prices and Tweet corpora and matching them to trading days after excluding non-trading dates. Tokenize available Twitter news corpora, remove words occurring less than 5 times to construct the vocabulary, and use GloVe embeddings within the two parallel paths. Whether normalization/statistics are fit only on the training set is unknown.
strict_requirements: Use the proposed COVID19-HPSMP Framework row from Table 1, not the standalone CNN Local/Global or standalone CNN-LSTM baselines.
Use the 5-day binary movement classification setup, not the later 50-50 or 60-40 trading backtests.
Use chronological train/validation/test dates as reported.
Use exact reported Table 1 metrics: Sensitivity 60, Specificity 71.11, Accuracy 66.48.
unknowns: Optimizer is not reported in the supplied context.
Loss function name is not reported in the supplied context.

COVID19-HPSMP: COVID-19 Adopted Hybrid and Parallel Deep Information Fusion Framework for Stock Price Movement Prediction
Experimental results and comparisons are presented in this section to evaluate the proposed hybrid COVID19-HPSMP framework for the task of stock movement prediction.
the introduced dataset is constructed based on the Dow Jones stock market index and its associated Twitter messages for the period of 01/01/2016 to 30/07/2020.

our dataframe is created by combining historical prices and Tweet corpora and matching them to the trading days.
we consider a ﬁve day horizon and used a batch size of 64 within 15 epoch.

within a 5 days prediction horizon, if the adjusted stock price of a speciﬁc day is more than that of the previous day, the output of that speciﬁc day would be 1. Then, the sum of the output values is computed over the 5 days horizon and if the sum is greater than a pre-deﬁned threshold of 3, we consider the ﬁnal output for that 5 day horizon to be 1, denoting a rise

when the adjusted stock price associated with a speciﬁc day is less than its previous day, value 0 is assigned as the output of that speciﬁc day. When the number of such 0 output values within the 5 days window is more than 3, we consider the ﬁnal output to be 0, representing the fall prediction/state.
Consequently, we considered 1, 152 trading days from January 2016 to July 2020 to build our dataset.

The COVID19 PRIMO dataset is then divided into a training set from January 2016 to January 2020, and a validation set from January 2020 to February 2020. Data from 01/03/2020 to 30/07/2020 is kept to be used for test purposes.

Market prices, including Adjusted close price (Adj. Close); Open price (Open); High price (High); Low price (Low); calculated target (Tar- get), and; Presence of COVID-19 in tweets are depicted in this ﬁgure.
Glove, which is an unsupervised word embedding algorithm, is used within the embedding modules of the two parallel paths of the COVID19-HPSMP.

The proposed COVID19-HPSMP consists of two parallel paths (hence hybrid), one based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) with Local/Global Attention modules, and one integrated CNN and Bi-directional Long Short term Memory (BLSTM) path.
The two parallel paths are followed by a multilayer fusion layer acting as a fusion centre that combines local- ized features.
